data.summary: This week, Ethan Qiu made 42 GitHub contribution-count commits across five public repositories, led by UTMIST/Misty with 31 and qiuethan/now with 4. He opened pull requests in UTMIST/Misty (#246, #254, #255, #256) and UTMIST/UTMIST (#472, #473, #481, #484), and opened issue UTMIST/UTMIST#483. He also reviewed pull requests in UTMIST/Misty and UTMIST/UTMIST, including UTMIST/Misty#206, #221, #246, #258, and UTMIST/UTMIST#456, #458, #476, and #486.
